parts.gloss: he who does not (negative pronominal suffix)

literal: He who does not desire pleasure, and says affliction is nature, experiencing sorrow he does not have.
translation: He who does not long for pleasure and considers suffering to be natural will never experience sorrow.
modern: இன்பத்தை விரும்பாதவனாய், துன்பம் என்பது வாழ்க்கையின் இயல்பான ஒன்று என்று கருதுபவன், துன்பமடைவது இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet explains how to remain unaffected by adversity. The author states that a person who does not crave or chase after pleasure, and who accepts that suffering is a natural part of life, will never feel the sting of sorrow. By expecting difficulties as a normal occurrence rather than an anomaly, one builds mental resilience. Thus, when hardships inevitably arrive, they do not cause distress to such a balanced mind.
